items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: In the meantime Norman Granz came, and he had the band. And he said, man, I want to record this band.

ctx.x: So how did you start playing with Parker? How did Parker start playing with Machito's band?

So after we marry, I really don't know exactly what brought us together. In the meantime Norman Granz came, and he had the band. And he said, man, I want to record this band. He came to me to -- would you like to record for me and so forth? You don't mind if I bring some solo with me. Then he had Flip Phillips and they contract with a jazz trombonist -- Charlie Parker -- so they brought Charlie to the Palladium.

So he had a band and so forth (inaudible). So we go rehearse. So when he came to rehearsal, said, you brought any kind of music. No, I -- he said, no, I ain't got no music (inaudible) we ain't prepared for you then. We ain't got nothing special for you to play. He said, no, no, never mind. Play me the -- anything that you have there.
